def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    # Tile all four quarter-turn orientations in a 2x2 layout.
    tl=[row[:] for row in grid]
    tr=[list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]  # rotate clockwise
    bl=[list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]  # rotate counterclockwise
    br=[row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]       # rotate 180 degrees
    return [tl[i]+tr[i] for i in range(n)] + [bl[i]+br[i] for i in range(n)]
